cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finished. I've left the cupboard shelves loose so you can practise the measuring I taught you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. There aren't any supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally checking underneath. It's a complete practice kit; you choose the heights around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it, not set homework. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll finish one shelf for you to copy. A complete demonstration, with room for you to show what you learned.

reason: Make each redefinition of incomplete work a supposedly deliberate teaching format, with B paid-work objection forcing A from practice kit to one-shelf demonstration.
